provenance.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, world estimates for 1950 (age pattern only); food composition tables (dietary energy)
provenance.notes: P4 (D-124, D-142): the standard schedule is the WPP 2024 world 1950 ASFR (TFR 4.83) and sex-specific central death rates by five-year band, used only as the age pattern; each block's fertility and child/adult mortality levels multiply it and are derived from simulated causes, starting from sourced 1900 levels (historical/p4/demography_1900.json). WPP 1951-2000 schedules are no longer inputs (validation targets only; see calibration/wpp_age_sex_reference.json and docs/P4_WPP_COMPARISON.md). The provisional 1900/1949 world schedules are removed. Sex ratio at birth 1.05 remains provisional. Food energy per kg, PROVISIONAL: grain 3,400 kcal (FAO food balance sheet conversion factors: wheat 3,340, milled rice 3,600, maize 3,650 kcal/kg, weighted toward wheat and rice); livestock (meat, carcass-weight mix) 2,300 kcal (FAO: bovine 2,350, ovine 2,600, pig meat 3,000+, poultry 1,700); fish 1,000 kcal (FAO fresh fish 800-1,200); food-products (flour, bread, sugar, dairy and preserved food mix) 2,500 kcal. The 1900 subsistence basket (0.527 kg grain, 0.03 kg each of livestock, fish and food-products per person per day) provides 1,966 kcal.
